name: Weekly GitHub Dev Summary → Claude → Discord

_readme.description: Every Friday at 17:00, fetches commits, closed issues, and merged PRs from a GitHub repository for the past 7 days, sends the data to Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) to generate a narrative dev summary, then posts it to a Discord channel via webhook.
variables: GITHUB_TOKEN — Personal Access Token with repo scope
GITHUB_REPO — Repository in owner/repo format (e.g. vercel/next.js)
